<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>public</access><active>true</active><api_name>global.DoctorUtils</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>true</client_callable><description/><name>DoctorUtils</name><script><![CDATA[var DoctorUtils = Class.create();
DoctorUtils.prototype = Object.extendsObject(AbstractAjaxProcessor, {

    getDoctorsByDepartmentName: function() {
        var departmentName = this.getParameter('sysparm_department_name');
        var result = [];

        var gr = new GlideRecord('u_doctor');
        gr.addQuery('u_department', departmentName);
        gr.query();

        while (gr.next()) {
            result.push({
                doctor_id: gr.getValue('u_number'),
            });
        }

        return JSON.stringify(result);
    }

});
]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script_include</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-07-29 16:22:10</sys_created_on><sys_id>2b224ce58387e21040a9c8efeeaad333</sys_id><sys_mod_count>10</sys_mod_count><sys_name>DoctorUtils</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Healthcare Management Application" source="ff960d23c32e2210dabb554d0501312e">ff960d23c32e2210dabb554d0501312e</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Healthcare Management Application">ff960d23c32e2210dabb554d0501312e</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_include_2b224ce58387e21040a9c8efeeaad333</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-07-31 05:18:00</sys_updated_on></sys_script_include></record_update>
